summary.text: Mary Ann Connelly is the Republican candidate for the Connecticut House of Representatives, District 101, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat John-Michael Parker. She is a retired registered nurse and a member of the Madison Board of Education.

paragraphs.text: Mary Ann Connelly said in a Ballotpedia survey that she is a retired registered nurse whose specialties were pediatrics and school nursing.
She said she raised five children, has ten grandchildren, and has lived in Madison with her husband for 30 years.
Connelly holds an at-large seat on the Madison school board, with a term that ends in 2029, and she said she is in her second term.
The Republican primary for District 101 was canceled, and Connelly advanced to the general election.
She listed education, safety, affordability (lowering taxes), health care and parental rights as the policy areas she is most passionate about.
